messages:
sam: Quick heads-up  opening a small docs PR to sync SDK snippets across Python/TS/Go. Focus: streaming iterator shape, pagination token rename, retries rename, and a tiny function-calling streaming example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4801

maria: Thanks. Please include a one-line migration mapping and keep quickstart snippets compact. What are the exact renames?

sam: Mapping: `page_token` -> `cursor_token` (request); responses now include `next_cursor` (was `cursor`). `retry_policy` -> `retries` (shape { attempts, backoff_ms? }). Streaming: Python/TS expose async iterators; Go uses `stream.Next(ctx)` loop. Also streaming chunks now include a `delta` field for partial structured output.

leo: For TS quickstart I'll use `for await` and a one-liner showing delta handling: `for await (const c of client.stream.generate({ model: 'rwd-1-stream', prompt, retries: { attempts: 3 } })) process.stdout.write(c.delta ?? c.text)` . Add inline note about buffering if you need sentence-level output.

anya: Nice. For Python quickstart propose compact example showing function-calling deltas + StreamError fallback:

```python
try:
    async for part in client.stream.generate(model="rwd-1-stream", prompt=prompt, retries={"attempts":2}):
        # handle partial structured output
        print(part.delta or part.text, end="")
except StreamError:
    # fallback to sync path
    resp = client.sync.generate(model="rwd-1", prompt=prompt)
    print(resp.text)
```

anya: Also add a short note in migration.md that `retries` shape is backward-compatible mapping from `retry_policy` so users can translate easily.

maria: For Go, show `defer stream.Close()` and `if err == io.EOF { break }` handling. Also add a tiny example for context cancellation pattern (cancel after X secs and fallback).

ci-bot: build/docs: linkcheck failed on `examples/old-pagination.md` -> 404 (CI job https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1700)

sam: I'll patch the broken link in the branch to `examples/pagination-migration.md` and push. Also added a short paragraph in model reference: "Quantized variants may increase per-token decode latency for streaming."

maria: Great. Assigning reviewers @leo and @anya. Merge after +2 approvals and green CI. :thumbsup:
